source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    stripe_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3]
    if not stripe_rows:
        return out
    first_vertical = max(stripe_rows) + 1
    guides = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(first_vertical, h))]
    for c in guides:
        hits = []
        for r in stripe_rows:
            row = grid[r]
            left = next((x for x in range(c - 1, -1, -1) if row[x]), None)
            right = next((x for x in range(c + 1, w) if row[x]), None)
            if left is None or right is None:
                continue
            if row[c] != 0:
                color = row[c]
            elif row[left] == row[right]:
                color = row[left]
            else:
                color = row[left] if c - left < right - c else row[right]
            hits.append((r, color))
            out[r][c] = color
        if hits:
            for r in range(hits[0][0] + 1):
                lower = next(((sr, color) for sr, color in hits if sr >= r), hits[0])
                out[r][c] = lower[1]
    return out
